definition.simple: The general direction price has moved in: up, down or sideways.
definition.balanced: An uptrend is often described as a series of higher [[swing-high|swing highs]] and higher [[swing-low|swing lows]]. A downtrend has lower highs and lower lows. When neither is clear, the market is called sideways or ranging. A trend describes the past. It can stop or turn at any time.

example: Swing lows at 1.09500, 1.09850 and 1.10100, with swing highs at 1.10200 and 1.10600, form higher lows and higher highs: an uptrend so far.
